newsitem.title: FRANCE: Thomson-CSF private sale likely - source.
newsitem.headline: Thomson-CSF private sale likely - source.

text.p: The French government is likely to privatise defence electronics firm Thomson-CSF through a private placement, a government source said on Tuesday.
"The chances for a private placement are strong," the source said. "A private placement would allow a faster (defence sector) restructuring.
The government has been trying to decide between a private placement and a stock market flotation for the privatisation.
The source also said the government would announce the sale terms before the end of the week or "at the latest at the beginning of next week".
Government officials at the defence, finance and industry ministries and at the prime minister's office refused to comment on French media reports the government favoured a private placement.
The government has said it will announce its decision by the end of the month.
